definitions.full: H7217. resh רֵאשׁ noun masculine Dan 7:6 head (Egyptian Aramaic, S-C Pap .; Palmyrene רש ; רֵישׁ ᵑ7 , Syriac ; Biblical Hebrew ראֹשׁ ); — construct ׳ר 7:1 ; emphatic הָ֯ 2:38 ; suffix רֵאשׁי 4:2 +, חָ֯ 2:28 , הֵּ֯ 2:32 +, הַּ֯ 7:20 , הֵ֯וֺן 3:27 ; plural absolute רֵאשִׁין 7:6 , suffix רָאשֵׁיהֹם (K §§ 53, Anm. b ); 63 Gu Hpt on the passage ) Ezra 5:10 ; — 1 head of man Dan 3:27 , compare 7:9 ; in vision: of image 2:32 , 38 , beast 7:6 , 20 . 2 head as seat of visions, רֵאשָׁךְ הֶזְוֵי , etc., Dan 2:28 ; 4:2 ; 4:7 ; 4:10 ; 7:1 , 15 . 3 = chief , ׳בְּר Ezra 5:10 in the capacity of their chiefs . 4 sum , essential content, of matters Dan 7:1 (Nes MM 40 beginning ).
